native.eWidget: Base widget: geometry, background, borders, transparency and stacking. It does not implement text, pixmap or list content.
native.eLabel: Text label with font, alignment, wrapping, outline, shadow and text scrolling. borderColor/borderWidth address the text outline; use widgetBorderColor/widgetBorderWidth for the rectangular widget border.
native.eButton: Native button derived from eLabel. It inherits the label attributes. Remote-control actions are connected in Python, not by a skin attribute.
native.eCanvas: Pixmap-derived drawing surface. A Canvas renderer consumes drawing instructions; font and text for those instructions are not eCanvas XML attributes.
native.eGauge: Native analogue gauge used by clock renderers. The Python renderer supplies values; the XML parser supplies geometry and the supported image attributes.
native.eInput: Native input widget. This is distinct from the commonly used Python Components.Input.Input, whose createWidget returns eLabel. Look up the actual component before selecting attributes.
native.eListbox: List viewport and selection control. Row content may be string, configuration, service or MultiContent data. Row-template attributes and component-specific attributes are additional contracts.
native.ePixmap: Image widget: pixmap, scaling and alpha test/blending, plus base widget appearance. No font or text alignment attributes.
native.ePositionGauge: Playback position and seek/cut marker widget. pointer and seekPointer use filename:x,y syntax; the source/renderer supplies playback and cut-list values.
native.eQRCode: QR-code widget. text supplies the encoded payload; errorCorrection, quietZone and colour/spacing options determine the generated symbol.
native.eRectangle: Decorative rectangle. Uses the base widget background, gradient, corner and border attributes.
native.eSlider: Progress or slider widget. Supports foreground/background images and gradients and the two-argument slider orientation parser. Several scrollbar names are compatibility mappings.
native.eStack: Layout container whose children use align. Geometry and appearance are inherited from eWidget; it is not a text label or listbox.
native.eSubtitleWidget: Native subtitle display surface. DVB/teletext subtitle styles are configured by the subtitle skin resources; they are not arbitrary label attributes on this widget.
native.eVideoWidget: Native video plane wrapper derived from eLabel. Inherited label methods exist, but video placement/decoder behaviour is controlled by Pig or VideoWindow and the receiver driver.
native.eWindow: Screen window. Adds title, window flags and animation mode to the base widget. Use these on the screen rather than on a Label renderer.

attribute_exceptions.eLabel.alphaTest: For eLabel and its subclasses, both on and blend enable text blending: setAlphatest maps any positive mode to the same boolean. The three-way pixmap distinction does not apply here.
attribute_exceptions.eSlider.scrollbarBackgroundColor: The implementation delegates to setBackgroundColor; this is a compatibility name for the slider background.
attribute_exceptions.eLabel.borderColor: Overrides the base implementation: colours the text outline. widgetBorderColor colours the widget rectangle.
attribute_exceptions.eLabel.borderWidth: Overrides the base implementation: text outline width. widgetBorderWidth sets the widget rectangle border.
attribute_exceptions.eButton.borderColor: Inherited eLabel override: text outline, not the widget rectangle.
attribute_exceptions.eButton.borderWidth: Inherited eLabel override: text outline, not the widget rectangle.
attribute_exceptions.eVideoWidget.borderColor: Inherited eLabel override: text outline, not the video-plane border.
attribute_exceptions.eVideoWidget.borderWidth: Inherited eLabel override: text outline, not the video-plane border.

renderers.Label: Displays upstream text. The renderer applies eLabel attributes and refreshes its text when the source changes.
renderers.FixedLabel: Keeps the XML label text while participating in a source/converter chain, for example for conditional visibility.
renderers.Pixmap: Displays an upstream pixmap, or chooses from the comma-separated pixmaps attribute using numeric source text. A source pixmap can take precedence.
renderers.Progress: Displays source value within source range, with clamping and an empty-value fallback. Uses eSlider attributes.
renderers.Listbox: Displays native list content provided upstream, commonly by XmlMultiContent or TemplatedMultiContent. It also propagates selection changes to the source.
renderers.Canvas: Replays upstream drawlist instructions into an eCanvas; drawing commands have their own arguments.
renderers.RunningText: Composite renderer: an eWidget viewport contains an eLabel. applySkin consumes font, text appearance and movement options before forwarding remaining attributes. Its effective options exceed the eWidget table.
renderers.VRunningText: Canvas-based moving text renderer with its own applySkin options. Do not assume it accepts exactly the same options as RunningText.
renderers.Picon: Resolves service picons and updates an ePixmap. Path and sizing decisions in applySkin supplement the native image attributes.
renderers.Pig: Places a live video plane using eVideoWidget. Decoder/PiP behaviour depends on Python configuration and hardware. Use OSD-only captures for documentation examples.
renderers.PositionGauge: Binds playback length, position and cutlist to ePositionGauge, including seek position updates.
renderers.QRCode: Renders upstream text as a QR code using eQRCode attributes.
renderers.Rectangle: Draws a decorative rectangle within a renderer chain, including conditional visibility.
renderers.FrontpanelLed: Controls a front-panel LED rather than drawing an OSD widget. Its constructor accepts LED index, patterns and a boolean-mode flag. It has no GUIComponent/applySkin lifecycle.
renderers.Renderer: Base class connecting GUIComponent lifecycle to the Element source graph. Use a concrete renderer in XML.

converters.Converter: Base Element subclass storing the argument string. Concrete converters expose properties or affect downstream elements.
converters.Poll: Polling helper mixed into converters. Poll does not inherit Converter and is not a standalone XML converter.
converters.ClockToText: Formats upstream time (seconds or a tuple) as text. Built-in formats are in TIME_OPTIONS; Format:, Separator: and Parse: modify formatting and tokenisation.
converters.ServicePosition: Converts the current playable service's seek interface to time text or gauge values. First argument selects the mode; subsequent comma-separated flags modify formatting.
converters.EventTime: Compatibility subclass of EventInfo. Its constructor and properties are inherited from EventInfo; inspect that base contract for available modes.
converters.EventInfo: Extracts event text, timing, progress and metadata. The selected constructor mode determines which output properties are meaningful.
converters.FrontendInfo: Converts frontend measurements and tuner status to text, boolean or value/range. Not every mode supports every output property; see the mode-specific assertions and recipes.
converters.ConditionalShowHide: Controls downstream visibility from source.boolean, optionally inverted or blinking. It forwards other attribute requests upstream and is not simply a boolean-to-text conversion.
converters.TemplatedMultiContent: Builds native list content from Python-expression templates. This is executable skin configuration; use templates from trusted sources.
converters.XmlMultiContent: Builds native list content from XML templates, styles and row field indexes. Read the list-template chapter for row contracts and matching source data.
converters.ServiceName: Formats service name/reference/provider information according to its constructor mode.
converters.ServiceInfo: Provides selected service information as text, booleans or numeric properties. Match the chosen mode to the renderer's expected input.
converters.TextCase: Changes the case of upstream text using its selected mode.
converters.ValueToPixmap: Maps upstream data to a pixmap according to its constructor mode, for an image renderer.
converters.ValueRange: Tests an upstream value against constructor-supplied numeric limits and exposes a boolean.
converters.ValueBitTest: Tests a bitmask against upstream value and exposes a boolean.

components.ScrollLabel: Composite scrollable text component. GUIcreate builds labels and a slider; applySkin distributes options between them. A single GUI_WIDGET/native-attribute union would be misleading.
components.Input: Python text-input component using VariableText and GUIComponent. createWidget returns eLabel; it is not the native eInput class.
components.ServiceList: Service-list component with legacy appearance options and modern templates. Its applySkin handles additional service-specific attributes before forwarding native list options.
components.ConfigList: Configuration-entry list. Native list styling and row fonts work with configuration content; editable values and actions are supplied by Python.
components.GUIComponent: Base lifecycle for named Python widgets: GUIcreate, applySkin, postWidgetCreate and preWidgetRemove. Instantiate concrete subclasses for actual screen content.
